lines.say: A gene sits at a locus on a chromosome. Its different versions are alleles.
Two the same is homozygous. Two different is heterozygous.
Law of segregation: the two alleles separate, so each gamete gets one.
Cross Rr with Rr. Build the Punnett square.
Three round to one wrinkled. Genotypes are 1 to 2 to 1.
A test cross with rr gives 1 to 1 if the parent was heterozygous.
Independent assortment: different genes are dealt out independently.
Each homologous pair lines up at random at metaphase one.
9 to 3 to 3 to 1 is just 3 to 1 times 3 to 1.
And means multiply. rryy is a quarter times a quarter, one sixteenth.
Or means add. Rr or rr is a half plus a quarter.
Real results never match exactly. Chi square asks if the gap is just chance.
The null hypothesis: any difference is due to chance.
556 seeds, expecting 9 to 3 to 3 to 1. Round yellow should be 312.75.
Add up all four classes. Chi square is 0.47.
Degrees of freedom is classes minus one, so 3. Critical value 7.81.
Small chi square, fits. Big chi square, quits.
Genes on the same chromosome are linked. They tend to travel together.
Only crossing over between them makes recombinant gametes.
Test cross flies: 410, 420, 85 and 85. The big two are the parents.
